ns2:section.sectionText: 1 hour. The goal of this discussion group is to provide a venue to discuss recent seminars posted on the popular ‘EcoEvo’ Seminar series. The over-arching goal purpose of this discussion group is to give students a broad overview of many studies in ecology and evolution. The EcoEvo seminar series is broadcast live on youtube at 11am CST on Wednesdays, but all past seminars are available upon demand. We will choose which seminars to watch and discuss. Each person will lead the discussion of an EcoEvo seminar at least 1 time, depending on the number of people who register. All participants will watch the assigned EcoEvo seminar to be discussed for that week.
